theme: Whimsical Nordic Fairytale - Illustrate scenes with a blend of Nordic folklore charm and whimsical fairytale elements. Capture the contrast between poverty and perceived wealth in rustic, quaint village settings and rich royal palaces. Stylize characters with exaggerated features derived from their occupations, such as comically long noses or large eyes, to embody the magical realism and moral lessons typical of folklore. Use pastel, earthy tones to evoke a nostalgic, dreamy atmosphere, with detailed costumes and settings reflecting 19th-century Scandinavian rural life. Emphasize the mood shift from hardship to magical assistance and eventual happiness through light, shadow, and composition, creating an enchanting yet humorously quaint narrative setting.
